opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million; Minimum grant amount: £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000; Minimum grant amount: £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000; Minimum grant amount: £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open to the public. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000; Minimum grant amount: £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority caring for nationally significant collections, open to the public. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces at libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000; Minimum grant amount: £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities at performing arts organisations, generally towards building or refurbishing these facilities.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000; Minimum grant amount: £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000; Minimum grant amount: £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority supporting special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for special schools and colleges to support pupils at secondary level to develop skills for employment or independent living.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000; Minimum grant amount: £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working with disability. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to help people with disabilities live more independently, particularly projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000; Minimum grant amount: £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working in mental health. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000; Minimum grant amount: £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority providing care and services for older people. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000; Minimum grant amount: £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and their families.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges with at least two years of exam results and a 'Good' or above inspection rating. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to help high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges improve teaching of subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts).
